title: The Painter and the Farmer
lines: The farmer had a big old barn.
The paint on it was cracked and gray.
A painter came out to help him.
She was an artist from the city.
She did not paint the barn red.
She made a big picture on it.
The farmer was cross, but now he is glad.
A visitor comes out to see it.

questions.ask: What did the painter do to the barn?
questions.listenFor: She made a big picture on it instead of painting it red.

questions.ask: How did the farmer feel at first?
questions.listenFor: Cross. He changed his mind by the end.

questions.ask: Would you paint your house a picture or one plain color? Why?
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. The reason is the point.
